decision: Rejection message uses 'rejected transition [<reason>]' prefix; the 'illegal' substring is carried by the illegal-transition reason code rather than a literal 'illegal transition' prefix.
alternatives: Keep literal 'illegal transition' prefix for all rejections (mislabels same-step no-ops)
Branch the prefix per reason code (extra conditional, no behavioral gain)
reasoning: ac-04 needs substring 'illegal' (carried by reason code illegal-transition); ac-05 needs same-step-no-op distinguishable and NOT tagged illegal-transition. Neutral wrapper satisfies both.
risk: A caller matching the OLD exact 'illegal transition:' prefix would miss; mitigated because callers catch generic Error and tests assert only the 'illegal' substring.
reviewHint: Confirm no downstream consumer regex-matches the exact 'illegal transition:' prefix.
